penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: UK tax guidance touches a regulated domain (tax advice); product must be carefully positioned as information/tools, not regulated financial advice, and may face legal scrutiny.

rationale: The buyer is a UK-based employed professional with real HMRC compliance anxiety — a specific, nameable person with money at stake and existing paid alternatives (TaxScouts at ~£99+, GoSimpleTax at ~£19/yr), confirming willingness to pay. The service is highly buildable: a Claude-powered decision-tree Q&A that outputs a plain-English verdict is a near-perfect fit for this factory. However, the regulated_industry penalty is material: UK tax guidance falls close enough to regulated financial/tax advice that positioning must be carefully managed, and Youval operating from Israel adds a layer of jurisdictional risk. Validate with a simple landing page and an email waitlist before building.
solution_plan: WHAT: A UK side-hustle tax clarity tool — a structured online Q&A that asks 5-8 questions about your income, expenses, and employment situation, then outputs a plain-English verdict on HMRC self-assessment obligations and the trading allowance, with a clear disclaimer that it is information, not regulated advice. BUILD: The factory builds a simple multi-step web form (Typeform-style, or a Claude-powered chat page) + a Stripe payment link at £4.99/use or £9.99/yr; Claude handles all Q&A logic from a well-structured HMRC rules knowledge base. SELL: Reach buyers via Reddit r/UKPersonalFinance, r/FreelanceUK, and targeted Facebook/Google ads around UK tax deadlines (January 31, April 5); the factory drafts all ad copy and posts for your approval before publishing. MAINTAIN: Fully automated — user pays → completes form → Claude generates verdict PDF → delivered by email; billing and refunds via Stripe; Claude handles FAQ support emails. The only recurring human touch is approving ad spend and reviewing any legal/compliance queries. IMPORTANT: Add a clear 'this is not regulated financial advice' disclaimer on every output and the landing page; consult a UK legal template service (e.g. Docular) before launch — the factory can draft the terms for your review.
notes: regulated_industry penalty drops total from 6.4 to 4.9, below the validate threshold of 5.5 without penalty. Stage is validate. build_gates: operational_autonomy (8) ✓, buildability_with_ai (9) ✓, buyer_clarity (6) ✓, willingness_to_pay (6) ✓ — all gates pass, but total is below min_total_to_build (6.5) after penalty. Validate with a 2-week landing page test targeting r/UKPersonalFinance before building.
